'''Saryta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] stationed on [[Quesh]] around [[3642 BBY]], when she was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Saryta appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Quesh. She is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
